description: Plan tasks carry a trust-model change level, and apply refuses to execute auto-fix tasks above the default ceiling (Level 2) so Level 3 stays advisory-only.
expectedBehavior: generatePlanContract labels every plan task with changeLevel 1, 2, or 3 derived deterministically from ruleId and file.
A plan artifact may raise a task's declared changeLevel but can never lower it below the level Playbook classifies from the task itself.
parsePlanArtifact rejects a declared changeLevel that is not 1, 2, or 3.
validateRemediationPlan and FixExecutor.apply reject any auto-fix task above Level 2 before any handler runs, including plugin handlers.
Non-auto-fix tasks are skipped by apply and are not gated by the ceiling.
